result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well structured, but several visual defects stand out: a persistent loading spinner overlaying the already-loaded 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' hero image, a horizontal carousel item ('Trattoria Piccol…') whose title is clipped at the screen edge, restaurant card images that appear heavily blurred/dark, and a heart (favourite) icon whose styling is inconsistent between cards. The second popular card is also cut off with no visible metadata before the bottom nav.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is still displayed in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' banner even though the image behind it has fully rendered, making the card look stuck/broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image load event fires; ensure the spinner is removed on both success and error states.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is cut off at the right edge and its title is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text rather than an intentional peek.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis / line clamping to card titles and align the carousel so the partially visible card is clipped predictably (or add proper edge padding and snap scrolling).

issues.description: Restaurant hero images are very dark and blurry with strong bokeh, making the food barely identifiable and reducing contrast for the white overlay badges (e.g. '20–30 min', '€0 delivery').
issues.suggestion: Use sharper, brighter imagery or reduce the darkening overlay; if the blur is a placeholder (LQIP), swap in the full-resolution image after load.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button background, size and icon colour across all cards.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or delivery info, so it looks unfinished rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the nav bar height so cards scroll clear of the tab bar, and consider fading/masking the cut-off edge.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with red dot, heart favourite buttons) have no visible text label; contrast of the grey placeholder text in the search field and the '€0.90 delivery' subtitles is also low.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels for icon buttons and darken secondary text to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast.
